clips.send: A mom with a teenager who seems low on energy sends it to try before medication - the hope it's simpler than they feared, and the relief of a free, natural list.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau's go-to list when his own mood dips, in his own words.

St. John's Wort: an herb he calls a fast, natural lift. B vitamins, which he says most people run low on and which help steady energy through the day. Guarana, a natural caffeine source he says skips the jitters.

His favorite: one small square of organic raw cacao, 85% dark, with nothing in it but cacao and a little raw cane sugar - what he calls a real mood elevator.

Which one on this list have you actually tried?
